'''Tornadoes''' were a common weather phenomenon on various [[Planet/Legends|planets]], especially [[Dilonexa XXIII]]. [[Orbit/Legends|Orbital]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] were capable of controlling weather and tornadoes on the planet, but could also be used to strike those that wanted to leave the planet but did not pay their dues.<ref name="TSC">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles|book=Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)}}</ref>
